name: Amir Prestige
notes: From their own listing drones (44 Via Roma, Isle of Capri, amirprestige.com.au, 2026-11-09). Wide drone pin: the white 'ap.' monogram on the sky with no circle or badge, a small gap, then a thin white line down to the house, with no dot and no outline. Location pins: white BOLD UPPERCASE wide sans labels (their site font is Garet; Söhne Breit Kräftig stands in) to the right of the top of a thin white line, with no dot and no distance. The close top-down oblique has no pin and no outline: the neighbourhood goes black & white and the lot stays colour (ZED-style mono surround). The monogram was cut from their 512 px favicon (logos/amir-prestige-ap-white.png), so ask for vector brand files before print. Sizes were estimated from 1920 px web copies. Updated 2026-11-10 after auditing all 18 of their listings (refs in raw/amir-prestige/pin-refs). Top-downs: a plain white outline (no fill, no ap.) over the B&W surround, with their 'Boundaries and dimensions are approximate only' note available in the Note box (off by default: Hunter didn't want it, 2026-11-11). Apartments and towers: drag the ap. sideways and the line elbows 90 degrees to the exact floor (elbow); outline the unit's floor band, set Fill to about 0.25 and the note to 'Outlines indicative' (small caps, bottom-left). Acreage: a white outline in full colour with the note set to None.
